verified.name: Engine Ventures
verified.thesis: Engine Ventures invests in early-stage deep tech companies developing hardware-based technologies across fields including biotech, robotics, green energy, agriculture, manufacturing, material science, and quantum computing.
verified.notes: Engine Ventures spun out as a separate investment firm from The Engine in 2023. The Engine itself is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit incubator and accelerator founded by MIT in 2016. No current senior partners explicitly named on sources. AUM not disclosed in provided sources. No flagship fund name identified in sources.
